# Code of conduct

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of background, identity, experience, or language. This policy applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, and other project spaces.

- Be respectful and patient. Critique ideas and code, not people.
- Explain disagreements with evidence and accept constructive feedback.
- Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, use sexualized content, or share another person's private information without consent.
- Keep discussions relevant and avoid spam or repeated disruptive behavior.

The maintainer, [@baba9811](https://github.com/baba9811), may edit or remove content, warn participants, lock conversations, or block participation according to the severity and recurrence of a violation. Decisions should be proportionate and applied consistently.
